name: Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare is a connectivity, security, and application platform that operates a global edge network for websites, APIs, and private infrastructure. Teams use it to manage domains and traffic, protect applications, accelerate delivery, run edge compute, and observe service behavior.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Cloudflare account through Relay-owned OAuth and bind one selected zone, then let agents list a bounded first page of account zones, inspect that exact zone, and read one fixed aggregate traffic overview for at most twenty-four hours. Relay V1 excludes DNS and configuration reads or writes, cache purge, Workers and Access, raw logs or request dimensions, arbitrary REST or GraphQL, pagination, token administration, billing, and broad export.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay needs a Cloudflare account-owned confidential OAuth client, the exact Railway callback, zone.read, analytics.read, and offline_access, publisher-domain verification, public visibility, and Railway staging client credentials. Those provider-console and environment actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create the client with authorization_code and refresh_token grants plus client_secret_basic, configure the exact callback and three scopes, verify relayconsole.work, promote it public, store credentials in Railway staging, then verify consent, exact account/zone binding, all three reads, refresh, revocation, permission/rate failures, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Cloudflare supports third-party authorization-code OAuth clients, confidential backend clients, provider scopes, public visibility, publisher-domain verification, and client-secret rotation.
Cloudflare publishes exact authorization, token, revocation, user-info, and OpenID endpoints for OAuth client integration.
Zone Read authorizes account-filtered bounded zone listing and returns zone lifecycle, account, status, type, and name-server fields with explicit pagination metadata.
The aggregate httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups dataset exposes request count, response bytes, and visits; Relay pins one exact-zone query and excludes dimensions and raw events.
